sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-01 and 2016-12-01, card C07987-K2 belonging to customer C07987 was subject to unauthorized transactions totaling $99.92 USD. The activity was categorized under pattern 'card_not_present_new_device', conducted via online channel. Cardholder verification confirmed that the cardholder did not authorize the transactions and remained in possession of the card. Investigation of the associated infrastructure identified device profile 'Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720', which is linked to 4 other cardholder accounts (C01104-K2, C01983-K1, C11309-K1), indicating a coordinated compromise. In accordance with Bank Fraud Policy Rule R6, a Suspicious Activity Report is filed. Card C07987-K2 has been blocked and connected accounts placed under enhanced monitoring.

stop_reason: Account baseline and evidence established clear finding without requiring step-up validation.
